{{Top|leg}}
'''Nairalav Shipping Co.''' was a shipping company active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was a front company used by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]]'s [[Valarian Syndicate|syndicate]] to launder money from its criminal activities. The company had an account in the [[Mos Espa Valid]] bank, on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] were transferred from Nairalav Shipping's bank account in Mos Espa Valid to pay a Valarian [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who had killed the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Hortrix Steelarm]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="SWG:Ttgp">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Time to get paid|Yavin system}}</ref>
